request_types.it_related: The message describes an IT problem or request (hardware, software, network, account, access or security).
request_types.non_it_related: The message is clearly outside IT support, e.g. HR/policy questions, greetings, small talk.
request_types.unclear: The message may need help but does not say what is wrong or what is needed, so it cannot be routed.

hardware.description: Physical devices and peripherals failing or misbehaving.

subcategories.startup_failure: Device will not power on, boot or start.
subcategories.display_issue: Screen or monitor is blank, flickering, distorted or has no signal.
subcategories.printer_issue: Any printer problem: paper jam, offline, not printing, broken.
subcategories.peripheral_issue: Keyboard, mouse, headset, webcam, docking station or other accessory problem.
subcategories.physical_damage: Device is cracked, dropped, water-damaged or otherwise physically broken.
subcategories.hardware_other: Hardware problem that fits none of the above.

subcategories.application_crash: An application closes, crashes or will not open.
subcategories.software_installation: Request to install, uninstall or license software.
subcategories.software_update: Request for, or problem with, an update or upgrade.
subcategories.performance_issue: Device or application is slow, freezes or hangs.
subcategories.software_error: An application shows an error message or behaves incorrectly.
subcategories.how_to_question: Question about how to use or configure software.
subcategories.software_other: Software problem that fits none of the above.

network.description: Connectivity: Wi-Fi, wired network, internet, VPN.

subcategories.wifi_connection: Cannot connect to Wi-Fi, Wi-Fi drops, or Wi-Fi is down.
subcategories.internet_connectivity: Connected to the network but there is no internet access.
subcategories.vpn_issue: VPN will not connect or keeps disconnecting.
subcategories.network_other: Network problem that fits none of the above.

subcategories.password_reset: User forgot their password or asks for a reset.
subcategories.login_failure: User knows their credentials but still cannot sign in.
subcategories.account_creation: Request to create or remove a user account.
subcategories.account_other: Account problem that fits none of the above.

access.description: Permissions to systems, folders and applications for a user who can already sign in.

subcategories.permission_request: Request for new access to a folder, system or application.
subcategories.permission_error: User gets an 'access denied' or similar error for something they should reach.
subcategories.application_access: User cannot reach or open an internal system or portal (not a credentials problem).
subcategories.access_other: Access problem that fits none of the above.

security.description: Anything that may put company data or systems at risk.

subcategories.phishing_suspicion: Suspicious email, message or link, especially asking for credentials.
subcategories.malware_suspicion: Virus, ransomware, pop-ups or other signs of malicious software.
subcategories.lost_or_stolen_device: A work device has been lost or stolen.
subcategories.data_breach: Data may have been exposed or accessed without authorisation.
subcategories.security_other: Security concern that fits none of the above.

other.description: Used for non-IT and unclear messages.

affected_devices.desktop: A desktop computer or PC is named.
affected_devices.monitor: A monitor or external screen is named.
affected_devices.mobile: A phone or tablet is named.
affected_devices.router: A router, modem or access point is named.
affected_devices.peripheral: A keyboard, mouse, headset, webcam or docking station is named.
affected_devices.other: A device is named that fits none of the above.
affected_devices.none: The issue is not about a device (accounts, access, security of accounts, non-IT messages).
affected_devices.unknown: A device is involved but the message does not say which one.

priorities.high: Security incident (phishing, malware, lost device, breach), or an outage stopping many people or a whole team/office.
priorities.medium: A problem that stops or seriously disrupts one person's (or a small group's) work.
priorities.low: Requests, questions, minor problems with a workaround, non-IT and unclear messages.
